description: This file implements cache management routines for MIPS architecture, specifically for LZMA compressed kernel loader on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes functions to flush and invalidate CPU caches, possibly for ensuring proper memory operation before/after loading kernel components.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
